Klasse ShutdownHookRegistry.ShutdownHook

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.misc.ShutdownHookRegistry.ShutdownHook
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Comparable<ShutdownHookRegistry.ShutdownHook>
Umschließende Klasse:
ShutdownHookRegistry
public static final class ShutdownHookRegistry.ShutdownHook extends Object implements Comparable<ShutdownHookRegistry.ShutdownHook>

Represents a single shutdown hook with name, priority, action, and timeout.

Shutdown hooks are comparable based on priority (higher first) and then name for stable ordering. Equality is based on name and priority only.

Instances should be created using ShutdownHookRegistry.shutdownHook(String, int, Runnable, Duration).
